interface.signature: klengthpref(arr: List[str], n: int, k: int, str: str) -> int

preconditions.description: The size of the array arr must be between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 1000 for s in arr)
preconditions.description: Each string in arr must have a length between 1 and 1000.
The integer k must be between 1 and 1000.
The length of str must be at least k.

preconditions.expression: all(c.islower() for c in str) and all(all(c.islower() for c in s) for s in arr)
preconditions.description: All characters in arr and str must be lowercase English alphabets.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(s[:k] == str[:k] for s in arr)
postconditions.description: The function returns the count of strings in arr whose prefix of length k matches the k-length prefix of str.
